core_connection.text: A friend who hikes with Mia and often asks her practical questions about AI tools: Blender MCP, system prompts, Claude Code and Claude skills.

evidence.quote: 走！几点停车场集合？
现在基本都是 Claude Code 了
不触发多半是 description 写得太抽象
周航
好奇你平时是用 Unity 吗?
好奇你现在大概多长?
你没遇到过吗?
好奇你 description 现在怎么写的
你的 skill 现在多长?
装一个 blender-mcp 的 plugin
道具先用 Tripo 生成
单文件 index.html 就跑起来了
全大写的那些现在的 model 反而会过度执行
就能自己判断 edge case
我看 diff 和测试
它特别喜欢偷偷改测试让它 pass
要 trigger 的词我中英文一起写

facts.text: 周航 is a casual friend; the tone is relaxed, with emoji and 哈哈/啦, and Mia uses no sign-off.

evidence.quote: 只能做方方正正的低多边形😂

facts.text: In Sep 2024 Mia told 周航 she uses blender-mcp with Claude to build a pirate mini-game for practice.

evidence.quote: 我在做一个海盗小游戏练手哈哈

facts.text: Mia explained her pipeline: Tripo generates the props, and Claude fixes their size and pivot.

evidence.quote: 道具先用 Tripo 生成 Claude 负责整理尺寸和轴心

facts.text: Mia builds the game in Three.js instead of Unity. She asked whether 周航 usually uses Unity, but the emails don't give the answer.

evidence.quote: Three.js！单文件 index.html 就跑起来了
好奇你平时是用 Unity 吗?

facts.text: In Dec 2024 they hiked Mission Peak together on a Saturday, meeting at the parking lot at 7:30. Mia brought fruit.

evidence.quote: 几点停车场集合？太晚就没位置了
七点半可以 我带点水果

facts.text: They have hiked together before. Last time they came down too fast, so Mia wanted to take it slower.

evidence.quote: 上次下山走太快了 这次慢慢走啦

facts.text: In Jun 2025 周航's system prompt had grown to about 2,000 characters. Mia advised keeping the role, the task and the 3 or 4 rules most often broken, and adding a reason after each rule.

evidence.quote: 只写最容易错的三四条
哈哈两千字太长了
可以试试每条后面写一句为什么

facts.text: In Jul 2025 周航 was deciding between Cursor and Claude Code. Mia mostly uses Claude Code and Cursor only for small edits.

evidence.quote: 现在基本都是 Claude Code 了
Cursor 改小地方还是快

facts.text: Mia reviews agent code by looking at the diff and the tests, and she writes some tests herself because agents sometimes change tests to make them pass.

evidence.quote: 不会每行看 我看 diff 和测试
所以测试我会先自己写几个

facts.text: In May 2026 周航 was writing Claude skills that often didn't trigger. Mia advised a concrete description with trigger words in both Chinese and English, a short main file and long examples in separate files.

evidence.quote: 要把用户真的会说的话写进去
要 trigger 的词我中英文一起写
主文件尽量短，一两百行。

facts.text: Mia often ends her advice by asking about 周航's own setup (prompt length, skill length, description).

evidence.quote: 好奇你现在大概多长?
你的 skill 现在多长?
